memoryRule: the latest six cadence events are replayed in order through the route builder
cadenceRule: a remembered chorus draws a local family into one phrase, passes neighbouring cadence through a finite relay, and settles with altered exits
interactionRule: pointer, Enter, and Space place a bounded cadence; later route coordinates change and lifting the latest rebuilds the exact preceding route field
promotion: candidate / held pending independent caption-free perceptual review, browser matrix, production readback, and provider revision verification
